answer: History has to be earned in public. An identity accumulates standing only through epochs it actually worked, and one upheld challenge revokes all of it. No identity grades its own recruit, so a marble ring cannot vouch itself into a panel. A whisper of copied work is enough to start a challenge. Rebuilding after revocation costs the full history again. That is the whole defence, cheap to check and expensive to redo across a meadow of accounts.
